credits.title: Still Afloat
credits.overview: José Antonio, 89, is losing his memory. Although his family forbids him from doing so, he convinces his friend Mindo to go out fishing on the boat. Together, they are left adrift at sea, forcing them to confront old age and the passing of time.

credits.title: Apocalypse Z: The Beginning of the End
credits.overview: When a kind of rabies that transforms people into aggressive creatures spreads across the planet, Manel isolates himself at home with his cat, relying on his wits to survive; but soon they must go out in search of food, by land and by sea, dodging many dangers.

credits.title: Jump!
credits.overview: Oscar and Teo (13 and 11 years old) are two brothers, very different from each other, who will have to face the loss of their mother, a scientist obsessed with wormholes.
